notes: Only this assigned page was accessed. The original was inspected once for layout, followed by each supplied overlapping native half once, reading every word, symbol, index, prime, accent, punctuation, revision and diagram against both witnesses, including agreements. All ten saved contextual crops were personally inspected. Their original-pixel boxes are in crop_boxes; each was enlarged with LANCZOS to width 3000, autocontrast and UnsharpMask. Only marginal_deleted was rotated (-23 degrees) before enlargement; its saved box remains the original rectangle.

One existing-crop reuse by this reader, marginal_deleted, tested the concrete lower-word candidates, unsupported extent estimates and terminal dots. No recrop or whole-page revisit was made. Main reader independently inspected the original and all ten crops and made targeted existing-crop revisits for qualifier, right_margin and the lower marginal candidates. No other-page source was consulted.
Manuscript 3 is at the upper right and 5 at the lower left. Both actual numerals are transcribed and inventoried. Archive numbers and H’s editorial page note generate no collation rows.

All connectors were checked at both ends. The first two in (14) have small caps/thickenings; the following two have real rightward heads. The first connector in (15) has a short upward terminal, and the parenthetical first connector of (18) has an upper cap. Literal graphics preserve these forms rather than interpreting them as complete arrows or subtraction. M0646 and M0647 receive other because a definite graphic is supplied instead of choosing an inadequate conventional minus or full-arrow glyph.

The hom/relèvement revision has a cancelled lower word and a live replacement above. Both witnesses already preserve that state. The qualifier starts with one large C/c curve immediately followed by dotted i; no independent opening parenthesis can be isolated. The supplied opener is removed, while the clearly written final closer remains. Initial case and the full compressed adverb stay qualified instead of being repaired by grammar.

Diagram (15) has two actual headed arrows, one upward-capped unheaded shaft and a detached cup. Its phi_xi label has no t and is below the diagonal. C’s swapped-side code would place it above/right for that up-left arrow; the explicit below option corrects the visible side, not merely syntax.

Annotated map (17) preserves the lower-left live number, a single upper T(Q-bar), the hanging =lim expression, its distinct leftward projective-limit arrow, and the curved directed leader from beneath T toward lim. The crossing upright is continuous with phi_i’s own loop and stem; no separate barred-arrow mark is added. TikZ inside the supplied diagram macro preserves these connected strokes and relative positions.

H’s local note already records a vertical crossing and locates the equality under T. Those acknowledged details are not counted as omissions. Its displayed equation nevertheless repeats T(Q-bar) before the lower equality without marking the added term editorial, which is one local duplicate-term row. The note’s explanatory quotation is not counted a second time. Its assignment of the large (17) to the cancelled marginal pencil text is separately contradicted by the live number’s ink, size and ordinary display-number column.

The tiny right-marginal Q has no secure detached bar: the apparent high arc is continuous with the nearby opening parenthesis. Literal Q is preferred with Q-bar retained as an alternative. All larger body Q-bars are distinct and preserved. The mathematical expectation of algebraic closure cannot establish a missing stroke.

The left marginal note remains wholly cancelled. Its opening il faut supposer chi=1 is recoverable. Si l’on veut, interpréter ça par, purement arithmétique and the new un objet candidate remain qualified where long hatches prevent secure segmentation. The middle unreadable run uses illegible{?}; C’s exact extent 6 is not established. The former final illegible{3} has a concrete but low-confidence un objet candidate, which receives its own content row. Physical run order is retained without rearranging the fragments into a completed grammatical argument.

The lowest marginal hatch ends in a large curved return followed by two detached dark points and a less secure third. Only unsure dots is supplied; the curved return is not counted as a point and no exact three-point count is asserted. All such ink and all unreadable regions remain within deletion state.

H uses no uncertain/ill macro on the marginal note, but explicitly declares that note unreadable. For recovered-fragment rows marked_in_H is true to acknowledge this local prose doubt; the evidence states its scope. H’s confident claim that (17) is part of that note is not itself covered by that flag.

The Z in (18) has two parallel diagonal strokes and is rendered with a doubled blackboard form. This alone does not independently establish a modern font-family error in C’s bold form, so no font-only row is counted. T shapes vary; the Pi-like appearance of T inside Aut is partly its adjoining opening parenthesis. No T-to-Pi substitution is inferred.

The final opération is one overtraced live word. Its initial case remains qualified; retracing does not establish a separately cancelled complete first copy. No comma is visible after the final pi_1(X prime), and C’s comma is removed. No punctuation is supplied after the final famille.

No proof, independent re-proof, computational certificate or substantive mathematical validity check was performed. The Kummer homomorphisms, character action and asserted compatibility were read and transcribed rather than verified, so check_events is empty. All discrepancy locations are covered by the ten existing evidence crops; none requires an uncovered half-page-only location.
